title: Terrible redesign
text: The 2025-26 redesign is an unusable mess. It depends heavily on location and has poor real-time access while in the subway, which was better with the previous version. You lose a lot of the system map, while you’re traveling in system, making it harder to anticipate upcoming stops on unfamiliar lines. Findability is really poor. It’s also difficult to find line-specific maps. If a long-time New Yorker struggles with it, I don’t know how a tourist would succeed in using this version.

title: Awful Update
text: This review is about express buses.  1. We can no longer see future schedules. The app only shows the times for the next upcoming buses. 2. We can’t easily see nearby buses anymore. We have to manually move around the map to check whether a bus is nearby. 3. Arrival times are often inaccurate. Sometimes the app says the next bus is 99 minutes away, then a bus shows up out of nowhere. Other times, it says a bus is coming soon, but it never arrives.

title: Inaccurate
text: So we’ve been waiting for over half an hour for a bus. The app currently gives the time for the 1st bus as 0 minutes away, which it is not. Assuming the icon for the bus is accurate it’s 7 blocks away; and I’m more inclined to believe that as the bus is nowhere in sight. Not the first time this has happened.   Also, not specific to the app, but 4 busses at once doesn’t help anyone. And I’m traveling with a senior, and you really need seating and shade at all stops.

title: Got worse!
text: I can only assume that the people giving this redesign  positive reviews are using it mostly for the train, which - fine. But the way the bus information is organized is an absolute disaster. When I search for a bus route, it pulls up every single bus stop on the route regardless of where in space I am. Why would it not pull up the closest stop to my current location on that line? It also won't let you choose which direction you're going in while searching, so it'll just show you, again, every available stop and force you to either scroll or type in the entire stop, which is annoying when you don't know the stop by heart.   PLEASE work on the UX here. This is still the only app with somewhat accurate arrival times, so I am forced to use it, but god is it a miserable experience.

title: LET ME SEE MY FAVORITES
text: This was a fantastic app and I deeply appreciate the effort to update and modernize it. But it’s completely destroyed the usability. Why can I not access my favorites? I don’t want to see the nearby lines, I want to see the lines I have saved to quick access, and the ability to see a list of other subway lines or to search for other bus lines. What if I’m trying to plan my trip and I’m not currently located near a train I will need to take? What then MTA? Please please please I’m begging you restore the functionality of the app. It’s useless right now and it’s very very frustrating.

title: Why take away directions in favorite stations??
text: In the old app, you could “favorite” a station in one direction only. I live in Clinton Hill between the G and C trains. To go to work my favorites were C toward Manhattan and G towards Queens. Not only can you not favorite directions in this new app, but my two trains I can take to work are opposite in my favorites so I constantly have to “swap” back and forth to see the times of the 2 trains I can take. This has made me late TWICE now forgetting that I was accidentally looking at a Brooklyn bound C train and not Manhattan since I’m so used to having my set up this way. Why take this feature away? I don’t see anything better about this new app.
